rows.meaning: gripping a climbable wall (not a rope or vine) without moving
rows.evaluatedBy: wall-climbing flag and no climb input
crouch flag and no movement input

rows.meaning: Poison or Spores is at least 20

rows.evaluatedBy: climbing flag and an item in hand

rows.meaning: a living teammate is within the card's radius
no living teammate is within the card's radius
far from every living teammate (outside the huddle radius)
